about.title: About us
about.intro: Win Transfer is a company specialized in passenger transport, focused on delivering a safe, punctual and professional service for companies, institutions, schools and organizations, as well as private transfers.
about.historyText: We have 20 years of experience in passenger transport and operate across all of Chile, 7 days a week, 24 hours a day. We serve companies inside and outside the Biobío Region, fixed personal transfers and daily trips to Carriel Sur Airport, always with a safe, punctual and professional service.
about.bannerAlt: Win Transfer vehicle in the field
about.missionText: To provide safe, punctual and personal passenger transport for companies, institutions and individuals across Chile, with professional drivers and direct coordination that adapts to every need.
about.visionText: To be the trusted passenger transport company in Chile, recognized for the safety, punctuality and quality of every trip.

legal.title: Terms & privacy
legal.draftNotice: Draft — pending legal review. Not binding until approved.
privacy: Win Transfer is a Chilean passenger transport company. This website is informational: its purpose is to let you learn about our services and get in touch.

What data we collect: only what you provide when contacting us through the form or WhatsApp — your name, a contact method (phone or email) and the details of your request (origin, destination, date, number of passengers and type of service).

How we collect it: this site does not store your data on its own servers or use a database. When you submit the form, WhatsApp opens with a message you choose to send; the conversation stays in your account and ours.
What we use it for: only to answer your inquiry, quote and coordinate your transfer. We do not use it for advertising or any other purpose.
Who we share it with: we do not sell or transfer your data to third parties. Contact takes place through WhatsApp (Meta Platforms), subject to that service's privacy policies.
Cookies: this site does not use tracking or advertising cookies. It only loads Google Fonts to display its content.
Your rights: you can ask us to stop contacting you or to delete the information you shared by writing to reservaswin@gmail.com.
terms: The content of this site (text, images and described services) is informational. The availability, conditions and prices of each service are confirmed directly when coordinating your transfer.
Bookings and requests are handled via WhatsApp or the contact channels shown. This site does not process online payments.
Specific booking, cancellation and liability policies will be provided when coordinating the service. [Pending definition and legal review.]
Win Transfer may update these terms. For any questions, write to us at reservaswin@gmail.com.
